parsed.main_gap: Lemma 2, the central weight-descent argument forcing all relevant primes into finitely many bounded-size minimal supports, is asserted without proof.

errors.description: Lemma 2 is essential and nontrivial: it is the only step that bounds the primes occurring across all minimal supports. Calling the descent standard does not establish how rejected supports, smaller coprime witnesses, minimality, and strict weight decrease combine. Everything proving finiteness of C depends on it.
errors.quote: This follows by a descent on the weight $w$ (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: Conditional on Lemma 2, the sunflower argument, finiteness deduction, and final periodicity argument are coherent. The omitted lemma is plausibly repairable, but it contains the proof’s central new mechanism and cannot count as a minor detail.
